recent_calls.summary: Dennis called to schedule a service appointment for a recall on his central air system, which is not cooling to his desired thermostat setting. He requested a regular service appointment around noon on Monday or Thursday at his home address. The agent noted his preferences and informed him that the team would follow up to confirm the appointment.

Deborah called after hours to report an urgent electrical issue with her air conditioning system that requires immediate attention. The agent documented the issue, flagged it as a priority, and informed Deborah that the team will contact her on the next business day. The agent also provided business hours and confirmed the call details before ending the call.

Deborah called to report that her air handler sparked and her AC stopped working, requiring immediate attention. The agent documented the issue, confirmed the service address and phone number, marked the request as urgent, and informed Deborah that the team will contact her on the next business day. The call ended with no further assistance requested.
The call was very brief with the agent greeting the user and checking if they were still on the line, but the user did not respond and hung up shortly after.
